WHATSAPP_CLOUD_STUDIO.TITLE: WhatsApp Cloud Studio
WHATSAPP_CLOUD_STUDIO.DESCRIPTION: Manage official templates, customer journeys, and consent-based broadcasts without leaving Chatwoot.

TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS.VALUE_PLACEHOLDER: Enter the value sent to this contact
TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS.LIQUID_HINT: Use a fixed value or a supported Liquid contact variable. Media must resolve to a public HTTPS URL.
TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS.STATIC_HINT: Use the exact value to send. Media must use a public HTTPS URL.
TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS.INCOMPLETE_SELECTED: Complete all required template values before publishing this journey.
TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS.UNSUPPORTED_SELECTED: This template uses a component that this automation editor cannot send safely. Select another approved template.
TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS.UNSUPPORTED_TEMPLATES: {count} approved template(s) use specialized Meta components and are disabled here to prevent failed sends.

API.LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the official WhatsApp workspace.

EMPTY.TITLE: No official WhatsApp inbox is connected
EMPTY.DESCRIPTION: Connect a WhatsApp Cloud API inbox to use templates, flows, native voice notes, and broadcasts.

OVERVIEW.TITLE: Official channel control center
OVERVIEW.DESCRIPTION: A single view of the Cloud API features and safeguards active for this inbox.

WINDOW.TITLE: 24-hour customer service window
WINDOW.INBOUND: A customer message opens or renews the 24-hour window.
WINDOW.OPEN: Inside the window, free-form messages and interactive replies are allowed.
WINDOW.CLOSED: Outside the window, start the conversation with an approved template.

VOICE.TITLE: Native voice notes
VOICE.DESCRIPTION: Recordings from the composer are remuxed to OGG/Opus and sent with the official voice-note flag. Regular audio attachments remain regular audio.
VOICE.NATIVE: Displayed as a recorded voice note

TEMPLATES.TITLE: Message templates
TEMPLATES.DESCRIPTION: Create, sync, inspect, and remove templates from the WhatsApp Business Account connected to this inbox.
TEMPLATES.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Sync templates from Meta or submit a new template for review.

CATEGORY_GUIDE.TITLE: Choose the category from the message purpose
CATEGORY_GUIDE.MARKETING_DESCRIPTION: Offers, product announcements, re-engagement, and promotional content.
CATEGORY_GUIDE.UTILITY_DESCRIPTION: Transactional updates tied to a user request, order, account, or service.
CATEGORY_GUIDE.AUTHENTICATION_DESCRIPTION: One-time passcodes require Meta's specialized OTP configuration and are not created by this form.

FORM.TITLE: Create message template
FORM.DESCRIPTION: Submit a template directly to Meta. Approval and final category are controlled by Meta.
FORM.NAME: Template name
FORM.HEADER_HINT: Up to 60 characters. Variables are not supported in this simple creator.
FORM.VARIABLE_HINT: Number variables sequentially. Every variable needs a sample value for Meta review.
FORM.VARIABLE_SEQUENCE_ERROR: Use consecutive numeric variables starting at 1, without gaps.
FORM.BUTTONS_HINT: Add up to three buttons supported by the selected template type.
FORM.BUTTON_VALIDATION_ERROR: Complete this button with a valid label and destination.

TEMPLATES.SYNC_ERROR: Could not sync templates from Meta.
TEMPLATES.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the template “{name}” from Meta? This cannot be undone.

FLOWS.TITLE: Automation journeys
FLOWS.DESCRIPTION: Build Chatwoot automations for this official inbox with messages, templates, waits, conditions, and actions. These journeys are separate from Meta's native WhatsApp Flows forms.
FLOWS.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Create a journey and connect its blocks to start automating official WhatsApp conversations.
FLOWS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the flow “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
FLOWS.PUBLISH_ERROR: The flow could not be published. Check that every required block is configured and connected.
FLOWS.STATUS_ERROR: Could not update the flow status.

VALIDATION.KEYWORD: Add at least one keyword before publishing this flow.
VALIDATION.CONNECTIONS: Connect every required path and remove unreachable blocks before publishing.
VALIDATION.TEMPLATE: Select a supported approved template and fill all of its required parameters.
VALIDATION.NODE: Finish configuring the required fields in every block before publishing.

EDITOR.TITLE: WhatsApp flow editor
EDITOR.DISCARD_CONFIRM: Discard the unsaved changes to this flow?
EDITOR.CONNECT_HELP: Drag a block output connector to the next block input. Select a connection to remove it.
EDITOR.TARGET_HANDLE: Use this block as the connection destination
EDITOR.SOURCE_HANDLE: Start a connection from this block
EDITOR.TRUE_HANDLE: Start the true branch from this condition
EDITOR.FALSE_HANDLE: Start the false branch from this condition
EDITOR.BUTTON_HANDLE: Start the branch for the “{title}” reply
EDITOR.SESSION_WARNING: Free-form and reply-button messages are sent only while the customer service window is open.
EDITOR.TEMPLATE_INFO: Approved templates can start or continue a conversation outside the 24-hour window.
EDITOR.TEMPLATE_VARIABLE_HINT: Enter the value sent to this contact
EDITOR.LABEL: Has label
EDITOR.PAN_HINT: Drag the background or hold the middle mouse button to move
EDITOR.CONNECTION_DESCRIPTION: Disconnect this path to leave both blocks free or insert another block between them.

BROADCASTS.TITLE: Consent-based broadcasts
BROADCASTS.DESCRIPTION: Send approved templates to labels, pasted numbers, or imported spreadsheets with eligibility checks, cost estimates, and delivery tracking.
BROADCASTS.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Create a broadcast after you have an approved template and an audience with valid opt-in.

GUARDRAILS.AUDIENCE_DESCRIPTION: Use labels, paste phone numbers, or import a CSV/XLSX spreadsheet without AI processing.
GUARDRAILS.OPTOUT_DESCRIPTION: Blocked, opted-out, or do-not-contact records are skipped before sending.
GUARDRAILS.COST_DESCRIPTION: Estimate the Meta charge before scheduling and track the estimated amount per recipient.

FORM.TITLE: Create official WhatsApp broadcast
FORM.DESCRIPTION: Select an approved template and a consented audience. No message is sent until the scheduled time.
FORM.NAME: Campaign name
FORM.LIQUID_HINT: Static value or supported Liquid variable
FORM.AUDIENCE_HINT: Contacts matching any selected label are deduplicated before sending.
FORM.CONSENT_TITLE: I confirm this audience has valid WhatsApp opt-in
FORM.CONSENT_DESCRIPTION: Only message people who asked to receive this type of WhatsApp communication. Opted-out, blocked, and do-not-contact records are still suppressed.

AUDIENCE.TITLE: Broadcast audience
AUDIENCE.DESCRIPTION: Choose existing labels or prepare a frozen list from pasted numbers or a spreadsheet.
AUDIENCE.PASTE_HINT: Enter one number per line. Brazilian local numbers receive country code 55 automatically.
AUDIENCE.FILE_HINT: CSV or XLSX, up to 5,000 contacts
AUDIENCE.FILE_TYPE_ERROR: Select a CSV or XLSX file.
AUDIENCE.CONSENT_REQUIRED: Confirm audience consent before preparing these contacts.
AUDIENCE.IMPORT_SUMMARY: {created} created, {updated} already existed, {duplicates} duplicate(s), and {ignored} suppressed.
AUDIENCE.IMPORT_SUCCESS: {count} contacts are ready for the broadcast.

ESTIMATE.TITLE: Pre-send estimate
ESTIMATE.DISCLAIMER: This is an operational estimate using configured Brazil rates. Meta determines the final bill and category.
ESTIMATE.EMPTY: Select a template and prepare an audience to calculate eligible recipients and the estimated charge.

BROADCASTS.ESTIMATE_ERROR: Could not calculate this audience estimate.
